\section[pēna]{\ml{പേന} (pēna) — a pen}

\label{lesson:ML-C140-pen}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for a month, then the Malayalam for a year.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{പേന}}
\textbf{\ml{പേന}} (\emph{pēna}) — \textquotedblleft{}a pen\textquotedblright{}. \textbf{\ml{ഒരു} \ml{പേന} \ml{തരൂ}} — \textquotedblleft{}please give me a pen\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
The first thing you ask to borrow.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{pēna}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{pēna}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} ask \emph{oru pēna tarū}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for a month, then the Malayalam for a year, then say \emph{pēna} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{പേന} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A pen\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
